passed_checks.check_name: Ensure HTTP HTTPS Target group defines Healthcheck
code_block:
resource "aws_lb_target_group" "api" {
  name        = "api-tg"
  port        = 8080
  protocol    = "HTTP"
  vpc_id      = var.vpc_id
  target_type = "ip"

  health_check {
    enabled             = true
    healthy_threshold   = 2
    interval            = 30
    matcher             = "200"
    path                = "/health"
    port                = "traffic-port"
    protocol            = "HTTP"
    timeout             = 5
    unhealthy_threshold = 3
  }
}
